thread:
ops-bot: [ALERT] Hosted inference /v1/generate 502/504 surge detected (03:22 UTC). Spike in error rate across eu/na edge nodes, multiple customers affected. Auto-opened war room: https://tools.redwood.internal/warrooms/5105006789 :rotating_light:

gina-sre: Ack, joining. Do we have scope? which routes and models impacted?

tom-eng: Initial triage: gateway timeouts -> upstream runtime returning delayed responses leading to 504s. Seeing connection queue growth on inference-gateway, some runtime pods OOMing then flapping. Started rolling restart of gateway nodes ~03:28 UTC.

priya-support: Reported from ACME Inc (ticket RED-7842) and BetaApps (RED-7849). Both seeing client-side timeouts at ~03:20 UTC. I posted an interim note to both. Need ETA for customer readout.

kyle-ml: quick repro snippet I ran against staging to amplify:
```
curl -X POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","input":"repeat test x100"}' -v
```
Logs show repeated lines: `kv_cache: growth=125% backpressure=active` then `runtime: async_flush timeout`. Looks like KV cache growth + GC pressure causing high tail latency.

gina-sre: Good catch. Are we seeing this across model sizes or only long-context jobs?

kyle-ml: Mostly long-context (>2k tokens) sessions, and a subset of heavy batch synthetic traffic from one customer grew KV entries.

tom-eng: Mitigation done: restarted affected runtime pods and gateway rolling restart completed. Error rate down from ~18% to ~3% in 15m. Re-enabled fallback route to smaller model for high-latency customers.

alex-oncall: Added temporary alert thresholds and pinned dashboards (latency P95/P99, runtime GC pause, kv_cache size). Keeping watch for next 60m. :eyes:

maya-pm: Let's schedule a readout + action review. Proposed postmortem readout at 11:30 PT and a customer-facing summary by EOD. OK?

priya-support: Draft customer message (short): "We're investigating increased timeouts affecting hosted inference since 03:20 UTC. We've applied mitigations (node restarts, fallback routing) and are monitoring. Engineering is doing an RCA and we'll follow up with timeline and remediation plan by EOD." Shall I send? :thumbsup:

gina-sre: Draft looks good. Please include link to interim mitigation steps and escalation contacts.

tom-eng: Quick action items (owners):
- short-term: roll gateway config (increase conn queue limit, temporary GC tweak) -> owner: tom-eng (done) :white_check_mark:
- mid-term: KV cache GC improvements + rate limiter for synthetic heavy sessions -> owner: kyle-ml (PR in flight)
- mid-term: customer-level rate limiting + auto-fallback to smaller model for high latency -> owner: priya-support + tom-eng
- long-term: refine autoscale policy for runtime pods and add eviction-safe GC -> owner: gina-sre
- postmortem writeup + timeline -> owner: maya-pm

kyle-ml: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kvgc/pull/512 (adds adaptive GC and metrics). Running canary now.

priya-support: I'll send customer interim message and link to war room. Will coordinate readout attendees.

alex-oncall: Monitoring looks stable but queueing still slightly elevated on one eu node. I left a soft restart scheduled in 30m if we see any regression.

gina-sre: Thanks everyone. Please add any further logs/snippets to the war room thread. We'll capture timelines and root cause for postmortem.

priya-support: Sent interim messages to ACME and BetaApps. They acknowleged and asked for ETA for fix -> I gave EOD.

maya-pm: I'll own the postmortem doc. Initial notes: cause = KV cache growth under synthetic heavy sessions causing GC/backpressure -> runtime slow responses -> gateway timeouts -> customer impact. Will fill details after logs. Meeting 11:30 PT.

ops-bot: War room closed (monitoring mode) at 04:05 UTC. Please continue updates in the postmortem thread.
